story.title: Michigan Senate Race Intensifies as Rogers and El-Sayed Call for Voter Turnout
story.summary: As Michigan's Senate race approaches its conclusion, candidates Mike Rogers and Abdul El-Sayed are urging voters to participate in the election. El-Sayed aims to become the first Muslim U.S. senator, while Rogers is gaining support from cross-party voters, highlighting the race's competitive nature.

timeline_highlights.title: Democrat Haley Stevens Endorses Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan Senate Race
timeline_highlights.summary: Democratic Congresswoman Haley Stevens has endorsed Republican Mike Rogers for the US Senate in Michigan, a move that has drawn criticism from her party. This endorsement comes just two days before the midterm elections and follows a public feud between Stevens and Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed over campaign ads. Stevens' decision is seen as a significant blow to El-Sayed's campaign.

event_overview.title: About Michigan Senate Race
event_overview.subject: Michigan Senate Race
event_overview.summary: The Michigan Senate race is the statewide 2026 election for one U.S. Senate seat representing Michigan. Voters are choosing a senator for a six-year term in the November 3, 2026 general election; the official ballot lists Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed, Republican nominee Mike Rogers, and candidates from four additional parties.

facts.label: Election administration
facts.value: The Michigan Department of State and its Bureau of Elections publish the official candidate listings, voter information, and election results resources for the statewide election.

facts.label: Primary context
facts.value: Michigan held its 2026 primary on August 4 before the November general election.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers the November 1-2, 2026 endorsement-related developments involving Haley Stevens, Mike Rogers, and Abdul El-Sayed, not the race’s full campaign, all ballot candidates, voting process, or final results.

related_stories.title: Voters Cast Ballots in 2026 U.S. Midterm Elections Amid Predictions of Change
related_stories.summary: On November 3, 2026, Americans are voting in midterm elections that will determine control of Congress for the final two years of President Donald Trump's term. All 435 House seats, 35 Senate seats, and 36 governorships are at stake. Poll watchers anticipate a potential shift in power, with predictions of a Democratic wave that could challenge the Republican majority.
